comment: How often, in minutes, upcoming cron schedule rows are pre-generated for this group.
modal: The interval, in minutes, at which pending jobs for this cron group are written ahead into the schedule table.

comment: How far ahead, in minutes, cron jobs are pre-generated for this group.
modal: How many minutes into the future schedule rows are created, so jobs for this cron group are queued before their run time.

comment: The window, in minutes, after which an un-run scheduled job is marked missed.
modal: If a scheduled job for this group has not started within this many minutes of its due time, it is marked as missed rather than run.

comment: How often, in minutes, completed cron history for this group is cleaned up.
modal: The interval, in minutes, between clean-ups of old schedule history records for this cron group.

comment: How long, in minutes, successful job records are kept before cleanup.
modal: How many minutes records of successfully completed jobs are retained in the schedule table before being removed, for this cron group.

comment: How long, in minutes, failed job records are kept before cleanup.
modal: How many minutes records of failed jobs are retained in the schedule table before being removed, for this cron group.

comment: Whether this cron group's jobs run in a separate PHP process.
modal: When **Yes**, jobs in this cron group are executed in their own PHP process, isolating them from other groups.
